The central focus is a set of three meat cleavers with dark, weathered handles and broad, rectangular steel blades showing signs of use (stains/patina). To the left are other hanging implements, including what appears to be a sharpening steel or skewer and wooden paddles/spatulas. The background includes textured wood and hints of red fabric or meat packaging. A purple cloth is visible in the bottom right corner.
